title: Rick Mitarotonda builds tension and cashes it in during Hot Tea
seoTitle: Rick Mitarotonda Hot Tea Solo: Tension and Release | Gametape Licks
show: Music Hall of Williamsburg, Brooklyn, January 2020 [confirm date]
summary: A nearly 15 minute Goose jam where Rick takes a solo, then leads the band up to a big peak.
description: Watch Rick Mitarotonda solo and lead the build to a peak in Goose's Hot Tea at Music Hall of Williamsburg. Includes a timestamped listening guide to tension and release.
intro: Goose played Hot Tea for almost 15 minutes this night, and the crowd was already loud from the song before it. Rick takes a long guitar solo, Peter Anspach follows on keys, and then Rick steers the whole band up to a peak.

That shape is lesson 2 stretched over a full jam. The tension climbs while the lines pull away from the chord, and the release arrives when the band lands together on home. Your ear learns to wait for that landing.
Watch the video once for the big picture. Then watch it again with the tension map from the lesson open and notice which notes feel unsettled and which ones feel like arriving.
